lines.text: Rehoboam reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, and Judah built high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles.
Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem and took the gold shields, so Rehoboam made silver shields instead.
Abijam walked in his father's sins, yet for David's sake the LORD gave him a son to succeed him.
Asa banished the male shrine prostitutes and burned his grandmother Maacah's Asherah pole in the Hinnom Valley.
Asa sent silver and gold to Ben-hadad, and Baasha stopped fortifying Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.
